title: BMA executor desktop types
description: v1.1 desktop.* control methods (machine-scoped executors that claim display.desktop, contract 1.11.0, additive). The desktop and its agent run from machine start; a desktop session only attaches to them (desktop-relay.md §1).

DesktopWallpaper.description: The environment's default wallpaper: sha256 (lowercase hex) of the image, its extension (png, jpg or webp) and size in bytes.

DesktopAttachResult.description: desktop.attach result. wallpaper is need when the attach named a wallpaper the machine does not have; the harness then sends it with desktop.wallpaper.
